parsed.explanation: No trans-specific offence is documented, but the heaviest feature is state-tolerated targeting: the national authority's police are reported to have arrested and tortured sexual minorities, with Islamic-law enforcement after an uprising, an official ban on LGBTQ organising, and no working recourse (no non-discrimination statute, contested law, vulnerable civil society) — tier 2, not merely social disapproval. Trans people are reached via public-morality provisions, and periodic transphobic threats and attacks plus documented flight of ~90 LGBT residents over violence corroborate a hostile climate. Social acceptance ranks 130th and is static. In one region a sodomy statute (10-14 years) is contested in force. Absent documented trans-specific police sweeps, universal facility/document rules, or dated trans violence counts, this sits above the 0.25 anchors but well below reduced-risk tiers.
